build.sources: the commit that adds or rewrites this metadata, rendered from its working tree before committing

comparison: Compared by tests/smoke/test_xr.cpp with G01's tolerance (6/255 per channel, at most 0.5% of the pixels) on this GPU and driver only.
description: I10 step 2's golden of the VR mode: the M0 test room in the fake runtime's headset, both eyes side by side (left, right), each an off-axis view of a Quest 3S's field 64 mm apart, the head standing 1.65 m above the scene camera's feet and facing its yaw; the last frame of a 30-frame run.
